jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(F) inventory: Windham Southeast School District, a unified union district (formed under the State Board's Nov. 28, 2018 Act 46 final order; member towns: Brattleboro, Dummerston, Guilford, Putney) listed as a member district of the Windham Southeast Supervisory Union. Operates PK-12. Its board is directly elected and is built here on its own terms.
Windham Southeast Supervisory Union / WSESD (official site).

board.post_note: WSESD: ten directors, residency allocated Brattleboro 4 / Dummerston 2 / Guilford 2 / Putney 2, all elected by the entire district electorate (modified at-large, Articles Arts. 10-11). One Brattleboro seat's current holder is held -- see the board sources.

sources.note: WSESD Members page (official, fetched 2026-10-22): Stanford (Dummerston, Chair) exp. Mar. 2028; Price (Brattleboro, Vice Chair) 2029; Schibley (Brattleboro, Clerk) 2028; Beekman (Putney) 2027; McAdoo (Putney) 2029; Fritts (Guilford) 2028; Smith (Dummerston) 2029; Remer (Guilford) 2027; Savage (Brattleboro) 2027 -- and Leavy (Brattleboro) exp. 2027, HELD (below). Structure: the Articles of Agreement (as amended Nov. 19, 2019), Art. 11 -- ten members, Brattleboro 4 / Dummerston 2 / Guilford 2 / Putney 2, 3-year terms; Art. 10(A)/(C) -- town-allocated seats "elected ... by a vote of the electorate of the entire New Union District" with ballots combined district-wide (modified at-large, the Articles' "Hybrid Model"); the official Jan. 27, 2026 Election Warning set three 3-year seats (Brattleboro, Dummerston, Putney) for Australian ballot on Town Meeting Day. HELD: Rich Leavy -- he holds the Brattleboro seat Tim Maciel vacated mid-2026 at Maciel's March 2027 expiry; the district announced the vacancy and sought applicants, but the board minutes recording an appointment vote were not fetched (a mid-term seat change with the predecessor's term still running) -- resolving document: the WSESD board minutes, spring-fall 2026. Tim Maciel: a member through the March 17, 2026 annual meeting minutes, absent from the current page -- ended 2026. Jessica Everlith (Dummerston): the district's vacancy announcement described an appointment serving until a March 4, 2025 election "to complete the remainder of the term, which is through March 2026"; she serves as a member from May 2025, signed the Jan. 2026 warning, and was thanked for her service March 17, 2026 -- minted ELECTED ended 2026 under the appointment-to-election pattern (her post-March-2025 service can only rest on the remainder election); the appointment vote and the 2025 return were not fetched. Two student representatives on the page are excluded.
